messages:
nina: Heads up — onboarding sample for JS SDK fails on Cloudflare Workers for a new hire. Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding-samples/tree/main/worker-hello

rahul: What's the runtime error?

nina: Worker error: \"Uncaught TypeError: default is not a constructor\". They used:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/js';
const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: SK });
```

leo: Classic ESM/CJS export mismatch. Workers need ESM; if exports resolve to CJS we get that shape.

tess: I inspected the published package.json in the tarball — exports currently point to a single CJS file under an unexpected key. That makes bundlers pick the wrong artifact.

rahul: Proposed quick fix for package.json exports (conditional map):
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
    "import": "./dist/index.esm.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
This should give Node and edge resolvers the right signal.

leo: Also add a small "./edge" subpath for an ESM-only tiny bundle (dist/index.edge.mjs). That helps Cloudflare/Vercel pick the worker-optimized build.

tess: If we add an edge artifact, ensure the bundler strips node-only optional deps and keeps auth/retry semantics identical. We caught subtle differences when fetch is polyfilled.

nina: This is blocking the new hire onboarding checklist — can we ship a point release? :worried:

rahul: I'll open a PR with the exports change, typesVersions fallback for older TS editors, and a CI smoke test that esbuilds the sample and runs it in a local worker runner. Will include a note about default export interop (export default createClient) so consumers using `import X from` work.

ci-bot: buildkite: #2789 passed (unit tests) — no worker smoke tests configured previously.

leo: One more ask: add a small test matrix comparing host vs edge auth/retry headers to ensure backoff and header ordering are identical. Edge polyfills can subtly change timing.

tess: Agreed. Also add a short line in RELEASE_NOTES.md about the conditional export change so integrators know why package resolution changed.

nina: Thanks — please paste the PR link here when ready and I'll verify the onboarding sample.
